lessons.title: Health and Wellbeing — A2
lessons.learn: Handle routine requests, time, travel, health, home, school, and work with connected practical Gujarati. Apply the skill to health & doctor with age-appropriate, respectful forms.

grammar.title: Health and Wellbeing structures
grammar.explain: Handle routine requests, time, travel, health, home, school, and work with connected practical Gujarati. Gujarati verbs and adjectives may show gender and number, while case relations and politeness shape natural word choice.
grammar.pattern: context + marked participants + object/complement + finite verb
mistakes: Do not copy English word order; Gujarati is normally verb-final. Keep gender, number, postpositions, and respectful તમે (tamē) consistent.
